final_candidates.decision_summary: Lys251 near the domain II hinge/fusion-loop region; charge-swap may modulate entry dynamics. Purely structurally motivated with no experimental support, hence moderate confidence.
Conservative surface substitution in domain III with low structural risk. Weak mechanistic link to replication fitness, kept as backup.

stop_reason.detail: Without access to external biological evidence, further rounds of self-review would not meaningfully improve the Top-3 ranking.

history.rationale: Conserved basic residue in the kl hairpin region; substitutions here can modulate membrane fusion kinetics and could favor replication in mammalian cells.
Lys251 sits near the domain II hinge/fusion-loop region; a charge-swap could alter receptor-mediated entry dynamics, but no evidence confirms direction of effect, so keep at moderate confidence.
Ala at this position in the stem region could reduce steric hindrance and slightly enhance viral assembly/budding efficiency.
Thr313 is surface-exposed in domain III; Ala may reduce glycosylation-adjacent steric constraints and is structurally conservative, so slight raise but no direct support.
Serine introduction in an internal DI loop may improve local hydrogen bonding and structural stability without disrupting the fold.
A264S is a conservative surface change with low structural risk, but no mechanistic link to replication fitness; keep as backup.
